summary: Geolocation flow on /map and /employer verified end-to-end via Playwright with context.grant_permissions(['geolocation']) + set_geolocation(12.95, 77.60). Positive path: /map silently auto-locates on mount (perm pre-granted), title flips to 'LIVE MAP · NEAR YOU', pre-permission banner is hidden, iframe srcdoc contains 'you = {lat:12.95,lng:77.6}' and renders the blue 'You are here' marker; /employer auto-locates on load, near-me button reads 'NEAR YOU' (orange), lead distances recomputed via haversine and sorted nearest-first ([0.1, 0.1, 0.1, 1.2, 1.2, 1.3]), mini map shows 'You are here'. Denied path on /map: with permissions cleared, initial banner shows ENABLE; tapping map-locate-btn hides banner and shows map-locate-denied with RETRY, title stays 'LIVE MAP · BENGALURU', no red screen. Regression OK: 50 pros + 14 employers still load, filter chips ALL/PROS/EMPLOYERS work, employer search='logo' returns 1 card, no new expo-location console errors on web. Pre-existing library warnings only.
action_items: No action required for the geolocation feature — all 4 scenarios in the review pass on web preview.

Native/mobile permission flow (canAskAgain=false → 'blocked' → OPEN SETTINGS) can only be verified on a real device/dev-client; web geolocation lacks canAskAgain semantics, so 'blocked' path is intentionally unreachable in web preview and code correctly falls back to 'denied' with RETRY.

Pre-existing (non-blocking, unrelated to this change) console warnings still present on /employer: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' and 'Accessing element.ref was removed in React 19' — likely from @gorhom/bottom-sheet or react-native-web internals; safe to defer.
critical_code_review_comments: useUserLocation.ts correctly separates silent mount-time reuse (getForegroundPermissionsAsync, no prompt) from user-intent requestLocation() honoring canAskAgain — matches native permission contract.
OSMMap.tsx re-centers on userLocation when provided (line 85: `userLocation || center`), so map recentering after locate works without a manual pan.

employer/index.tsx recomputes lead.distance_km via haversine and sorts ascending only when coords are present — original seeded distances remain when location denied, so denied path degrades gracefully.
seed_data_creation: None. Auth not required for /map or /employer.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Playwright web geolocation must be pre-granted BEFORE goto: `await context.grant_permissions(['geolocation'], origin=<preview_url>); await context.set_geolocation({latitude,longitude})`. On web, expo-location's canAskAgain is not exposed → denied path only, never 'blocked' banner via web preview. Iframe srcdoc always textually contains the literal string 'You are here' inside the JS if-block; to prove the marker actually renders, check for the runtime coord assignment `you = {"lat":..,"lng":..}` (non-null), not just the popup text.
rca_of_issue: Original user complaint 'This open map is not getting my current location' — resolved. Verified: (1) app.json has expo-location plugin + iOS NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription + Android ACCESS_COARSE/FINE_LOCATION, (2) useUserLocation hook implements silent-reuse + explicit-request permission contract with canAskAgain → blocked mapping, (3) OSMMap recenters + renders 'You are here' blue marker, (4) /map shows pre-permission banner + locate button + denied fallback, (5) /employer recomputes real distances via haversine and re-sorts nearest-first.
